name: vexorion-grunt
description: VexorionGrunt real-time telemetry, architecture orchestrator and testing framework
author: widodoprsd <widodoprsd@gmail.com>

scripts.build:cdn: esbuild src/cdn-entry.js --bundle --format=iife --outfile=cdn/vexorion.js && esbuild src/cdn-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --outfile=cdn/vexorion.min.js && esbuild src/cdn-entry.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=cdn/vexorion.esm.js && esbuild src/cdn-entry.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --outfile=cdn/vexorion.esm.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:cdn && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
